top_choice_rationale: GLP-1 is an unbroken, mature line from proglucagon processing and human incretin physiology (Holst, Drucker) through identification of the active truncated peptide (Mojsov) to therapies with large, independently confirmed benefits in diabetes, obesity and cardiovascular and renal outcomes. The three-person allocation fits the limit and the citation stays on the discovery. The contested priority of the third name against Habener and colleagues is a real weakness, but it does not justify withholding the prize.
